top: Solomon Islands has told Beijing it will not renew its 2022 security pact with China, and its prime minister Matthew Wale meets Anthony Albanese in Canberra today to lock in a new treaty with Australia.
Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive after pressure from the White House, sending its shares up about 31% and giving Wall Street its best day since April 2025.
COP31 in Antalya collapsed on Sunday without its main deal, after the EU and others refused a final text that did not even mention fossil fuels.
COP31 in Antalya ran into a second day of overtime with no deal, as Chris Bowen and the Turkish presidency tried to rescue a text that still leaves out fossil fuels.
Wall Street's AI rout deepened overnight, pushing the S&P 500 and Dow into a correction and wiping out the Nasdaq's 2026 gains as Nvidia sank about 14% on reports of an SEC accounting probe.
Trump, Xi and Putin agreed in Shenzhen that a nuclear war can never be won and promised talks on cutting nuclear risks, but set no timetable.
Donald Trump has landed in Shenzhen for today's first ever three way meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, though both sides are playing down hopes of big breakthroughs.
Nvidia smashed forecasts in its first results since Jensen Huang quit, with revenue more than doubling to US$115.8 billion, lifting its shares after hours following another ugly day on Wall Street.
A sharp AI selloff hit Wall Street overnight, with the Nasdaq down about 2.5% and Nvidia off 4% a day before its first results since Jensen Huang quit, so the ASX is set to open lower.
Iran fired drones at a US base in Bahrain for the first time in two months and says tankers hit mines near Hormuz, days before Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen.
Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin plan their first ever three way meeting on the sidelines of APEC in Shenzhen this week, with nuclear arms control top of the agenda.
A global Microsoft outage knocked out Outlook, Teams and Copilot, hitting the AFP and ASIO and prompting Canberra to activate a special recovery deal with the tech giant.
Jensen Huang has quit as Nvidia's chief executive amid an affair scandal, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in and the shares closing down about 4%.
Russia and Ukraine wrapped up two days of US brokered talks in Abu Dhabi with an in principle deal on the biggest prisoner swap of the war, but no ceasefire.
Canberra will create a new AI safety regulator with real penalties, after an OpenAI agent got into a government Medicare data portal without permission.
Wall Street had its best day since April as oil slid about 6% on hopes of a US and Iran deal, even with Nvidia sinking over its CEO's reported link to an alleged Chinese spy.
Israel's Knesset is sworn in tomorrow, and Gadi Eisenkot's first test is whether he can dump Netanyahu's speaker.
Israel's president has picked Gadi Eisenkot, not Benjamin Netanyahu, to try to form the next government, after 67 of 120 MPs backed him.
Wall Street bounced on Friday after its AI rout, helped by a strong US jobs report, but the ASX still slipped 0.5% to 9,020.8.
Wall Street had its worst day since April 2025, with the Nasdaq sliding into correction as AI and chip stocks were hit by fears of tougher regulation after the Democrats' midterm sweep.
The RBA lifted the cash rate to 4.85%, the highest since 2008, in a split 6 to 3 vote that hints at a pause.
Israel's president starts coalition talks on Wednesday after an election that gave neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot a majority.
Alphabet's slide has now wiped roughly half a trillion US dollars off its value, and Amazon's mixed results kept Wall Street nervous about the cost of AI.
Israel's vote count is done at 99.9 percent and still gives Netanyahu's bloc only 53 of 120 seats, with the Arab parties on 19 and holding the key.
Australian inflation hit 4.3% in September, which makes an RBA rate rise on Melbourne Cup Day (3 November) close to a sure thing.
Israel's election has ended without a clear winner, with exit polls showing neither Netanyahu's bloc nor the opposition reaching a 61 seat majority.
Israelis vote today in an election that polls say could leave neither side with a majority.
Lula has won a record fourth term as Brazil's president, but Flávio Bolsonaro is refusing to concede and plans to challenge the result.
Brazil picks its president today in a runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro that polls call a coin flip.
